description:
## v1.0.0

First release for Radio Indonesia (com.appmind.radios.id) 4.2.30 XAPK.

- Premium unlock: no visual ads and the music equalizer.
- Disable data collection SDKs: Weplan, Wavebrook and its partners, Speedchecker, LowLagLabs and GeoTruth.
- Disable analytics: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions, and the Facebook SDK.
- Disable ad SDKs: keeps every ad network and AppHarbr from starting (requires Premium unlock).
